name: SHoEbox width versus expert count: 25M bytes
primary_comparison: Mean validation at 23M, 24M and 25M, then paired seed mean; also report each 25M endpoint and elapsed training seconds.
checkpoint_selection: Minimum shared validation within each run; endpoint retained independently.
test_policy: Test remains sealed during calibration and the six 25M runs. No test-based arm or checkpoint selection.
stop_policy: Complete all 25M byte targets. Stop and preserve the last checkpoint on nonfinite values or integrity failure; no validation-based early stopping.
